name: D15 named superseding assessment (ADR-0084 gate reclassification)
scope: Reclassify the D15 gate scope for the current adopted range under Accepted ADR-0084, using the merged real business-recovery acceptance and the coherent DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 repository default upgrade as evidence. It does not rewrite the historical D15-4/D15-5/D15-G verdicts, does not mark native independent child resume as implemented, does not unfreeze R3, does not authorize a production deployment/release/tag and does not start 0.10.

required_components.name: historical D15-G verdict preserved un-rewritten
required_components.description: The committed D15-G verdict remains NO_GO over the audit-time D15-2..D15-5 snapshot with exactly the four atomic required blockers; this assessment references it but does not rewrite it.

required_components.name: ADR-0084 replacement gate (BYQ session failure containment and business recovery)
required_components.description: The current required gate passed at implementation level and in a real isolated service combination, with truthful cleanup and production untouched.

required_components.name: coherent DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 repository default upgrade with preserved rollback
required_components.description: The repository default dependency/selector is the coherent 0.1.5-rc.1 pairing, readiness matched, and the 0.1.2rc1 rollback baseline is preserved. It does not claim a production deployment.

required_components.name: B1 subagent-child-crash
required_components.description: No out-of-process continuable provider exists in the examined releases (rc.2/alpha.2); the historical D15-4 required item stays BLOCKED. It is not reclassified to PASS.

required_components.name: B2 subagent-byq-adapter-restart
required_components.description: No committed BYQ composition rebinds a persisted continuable child across an adapter restart; the candidate probe is external/dependency BLOCKED and the historical D15-4 required item stays BLOCKED.

required_components.name: B3 terminal-adapter-restart (candidate/qualification layer)
required_components.description: Candidate/qualification-layer minimal TerminalAttachment lifecycle PASS; it does not rewrite the historical D15-5 BLOCKED snapshot and is not production R4 wiring.

required_components.name: B4 terminal-dsh-runtime-restart (candidate/qualification layer)
required_components.description: Candidate/qualification-layer real DSH runtime restart PASS with truthful lost/interrupted semantics; it does not rewrite the historical D15-5/D15-G snapshots and is not production R4 wiring.

required_components.name: native independent child resume implementation claim
required_components.description: Native independent child-process resume remains unimplemented; B1/B2 are BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and no BLOCKED item may be reported as an implemented capability.

required_components.name: candidate compatibility for the actually adopted scope
required_components.description: For the adopted scope the candidate compatibility is satisfied by the real containment/recovery gate, the coherent default upgrade and the B3/B4 candidate PASS. Per ADR-0084 B1/B2 do not gate candidate compatibility for this scope.

required_components.name: candidate promotion for the actually adopted scope
required_components.description: The candidate is promoted to the repository default dependency/selector only. A production deployment, release or tag is a separate decision and is not performed or claimed.

required_components.name: R3 full unfreeze
required_components.description: R3 full resume stays NO: the historical D15-G remains NO_GO and native independent child recovery is unimplemented. The bounded R3 scope is captured separately and is not a full unfreeze.

fail_closed: decision not in the decision vocabulary
missing or extra required component id (closed set)
a claimed component status that differs from the independently derived status
a claimed r3_permitted_scope that differs from the derived bounded scope
an assessment that reports a BLOCKED_EXTERNAL capability as PASS/IMPLEMENTED
an assessment that reports native independent child resume as implemented
an assessment that reports a production deployment, release or tag
an assessment that claims R3 full resume (r3_resume=YES)
an assessment that drops or widens the bounded R3 scope
a decision that differs from the independently derived decision
unreadable or malformed source evidence (fail closed to MISSING, never a default pass)
an assessment that declares its own verdict/coverage/established fields
a replacement gate that is not PASS while the assessment claims an established assessment
a coherent default upgrade that is not PASS while the assessment claims an established assessment
an assessment that rewrites the historical D15-G verdict into GO/PASS

notes.purpose: A named, machine-readable, fail-able superseding assessment. It truthfully reclassifies the D15 gate scope for the current adopted range under ADR-0084 without rewriting the historical D15-G verdict. The observer fails (non-zero) when the assessment is invalid, dishonest, overclaims implemented native child resume, hides a regression in the replacement gate, or relies on missing evidence.
notes.gate_model: B1/B2 remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and are not global prerequisites for 0.9.x closeout, candidate compatibility, the bounded R3 scope or unrelated roadmap work (ADR-0084 §3). The replacement gate is BYQ session failure containment and business recovery.
notes.r3_model: r3_permitted_scope is the bounded thin-supervisor scope only (safe failure, observation, cleanup, new generation recovery). r3_resume stays NO because native independent child recovery is unimplemented and the historical D15-G remains NO_GO.
notes.production_model: Promotion in this assessment means the repository default dependency/selector only. Production deployment, release and tag remain separate decisions and are neither performed nor claimed.
